id: title:jurajmajerik:clarify the enable surveys toggle in the quick survey form

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the placement and conditional visibility of the survey enable toggle, potentially affecting user ability to enable surveys.
review.reason: Adds a conditional warning banner and an enable toggle when surveys are disabled, while removing the toggle from a different location. This is a localized UI behavior change.
review.uncertainty: The complete implementation and broader context are not supplied, so the actual benefit and potential impact are not demonstrated.

observations.limitations: Only P1.F1.H1 and P1.F1.H2 are supplied. No score assigned. No tier assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a conditional warning banner and an enable toggle when surveys are disabled; removes the same toggle from a different location.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows a user to enable surveys when the feature is disabled, rather than showing an error or nothing.
